notes: Threads waiting on background work now show "Watching" instead of looking done, keep their process alive until the work lands, wake visibly, and take queued subagent reports in one turn. A Claude thread that ended its turn with a run_in_background Bash, a Monitor, a CI poll or a session cron used to read as idle, get its process (and the tasks with it) killed by the 10-minute idle sweep, and stream its self-wake turn into an idle thread with no spinner; the user typed "continue" to revive them. New session status `watching` (shared/events.ts, in LIVE_STATUSES): the driver (drivers/claude.ts) keeps the live non-ambient task set from system/background_tasks_changed, names tasks from task_started, records session crons through a Stop hook, settles `result` to watching while any is live, and treats an assistant/stream_event/init arriving while idle as a wake turn (status running, so busySince and the overdue watchdog arm); each task_notification lands as a "Background task completed: <desc>" transcript row (new background-task event) and the live descriptions ride a background-tasks event. The registry (sessions.ts) never sweeps a watching handle (no cap), shows "Waiting on <desc>" / "Waiting on N tasks: a, b" in the activity line, settles a watching row idle when its handle drops, resets a persisted watching at boot, treats running → watching as no parent settle and watching → idle as one, lets Stop drop the handle, and drainReports now sends every parked subagent report in ONE turn with one agent-report row each. waitForSettled (orchestration.ts) sleeps through watching. Renderer: fold closes the turn on watching without busy, StatusDot/TabIndicator show a neutral pulsing "Watching" with the tasks on hover, fleet counts and agent lines, turn clock, header and title-bar Stop all know the status. Tests: claude-tasks.test.ts, sessions-watching.test.ts, orchestration.test.ts, fold/agents/turnClock/threadStripModel tests.
